notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard library, and the adapter-supplied application FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, provider package, and callback configuration. It sends the standard federation-level HLAsetSwitches interaction from joined federates and observes the standard discovery and provideAttributeValueUpdate callbacks around ordinary object registration. It asserts no provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport details, or internal switch state.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard-MIM interaction and parameter lookup, receive-order sendInteraction, ordinary object publication/subscription/registration, callback servicing, and federation lifecycle with FederateAmbassador discovery and provideAttributeValueUpdate callbacks
